title: Actual internal total oplax arrow under the section equivalence
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $T$ use its small pro-étale site, small relative to module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the pulled-back ring object $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and its reconstructed section-ring sheaf, and the fixed exact internal/section module equivalence $E_T$ [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use the ordinary operations and universe convention of [def-pd-section-module-operations-data]. Let $q_T^{\mathrm i},q_T^{\mathrm s}$ denote the internal and section homotopy-to-derived localizations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and write $\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm i},\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm s}$ for the full subcategories of K-flat complexes with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], with the corresponding exact-tensor and acyclic-total-tensor tests internally. All total tensors below are signed direct-sum cochain totals [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and all derived tensors are relative to $R_T$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism. Let $F=f^*_{\mathrm{sec}}$ be the specified module pullback and $F_{\mathrm i}=f^*_{\mathrm{int}}$ its internal counterpart, with their fixed ordinary operation comparison $E_XF_{\mathrm i}\cong FE_Y$. Give $F_{\mathrm i}$ its actual oplax tensor and unit maps, the adjunction mates of the specified direct-image lax maps, as in [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors]. Let $b_{P,Q}$ be the section ringed cochain comparison of [lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence]. For arbitrary unbounded section complexes $P,Q$ it has type
$$b_{P,Q}:F\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_{R_Y}Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes_{R_X}FQ).$$
Then the image under $E_X$ of the actual internal total oplax arrow on any internal complexes $P_{\mathrm i},Q_{\mathrm i}$, conjugated by the fixed ordinary operation and signed-total comparisons, equals $b_{E_YP_{\mathrm i},E_YQ_{\mathrm i}}$ as a chain map, and hence after homotopy quotient and derived localization. The coproduct comparison in that conjugation is the canonical left-adjoint comparison, and the total differential is $d_P\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_Q$ on bidegree $(p,q)$. With $S=R_X$, $R'=f^{-1}R_Y$, its local summand formula is $s\otimes(x\otimes y)\mapsto(s\otimes x)\otimes(1\otimes y)$; the actual inverse total map has formula $(s\otimes x)\otimes(t\otimes y)\mapsto st\otimes(x\otimes y)$. Both inverse equations hold as chain maps. Under the same comparisons the internal total unit map on $R_Y[0]$ equals ordinary scalar multiplication $F(R_Y[0])\cong R_X[0]$. The actual internal total associator and both unitor diagrams become the ringed cochain diagrams with $b$ and this unit. In particular their images give the specified natural isomorphism in the unbounded derived category,
$$q_X^{\mathrm s}F\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\xrightarrow{\ q_X^{\mathrm s}(b_{P,Q})\ }q_X^{\mathrm s}\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes FQ),$$
with the same inverse, unit and constraint equalities. These are equalities of the specified maps, also for infinite degreewise sums, and require no flatness or boundedness of $P,Q$.

proof.text: Use the proved single-functor signed-total comparison and its image-coproduct extensionality (lem-sfb-termwise-strong-monoidal). The normalized equivalence totalComparison has its bidegree restriction by totalComparison_existsUnique. Precompose the internal/section tensor square in degree n with every image of the injection indexed by p+q=n. Expand the actual internal total comparison, then the equivalence total comparison, then the tensor of the termwise pull comparisons. Naturality of the fixed pull comparison moves the source injection across the square. The ordinary normalization equation identifies the remaining ordinary component with the specified section component. The image-coproduct universal property gives the square, and cancellation of the source transport isomorphisms gives equality of the conjugated chain map and sectionTotalIso.hom. The full degree coproduct is preserved by the pullback adjunction and the section equivalence; no boundedness is imposed.

proof.text: Equality of the forward isomorphisms gives equality of their inverses. Independently cancel the forward total comparison in its summand restriction to obtain the inverse restriction, both internally and for section modules. Evaluate the internal forward and inverse restrictions on the scalar-extension generators and substitute the two ordinary normalization formulas. This gives the specified local scalar splitting and contraction formulas. All maps are chain maps by construction using the signed total tensor, so both inverse laws are the isomorphism laws.

proof.text: For the unit transport square, in degree zero unfold the canonical single-complex comparisons and apply the ordinary unit normalization equation. In every other degree the source is zero, since the two additive functors preserve the zero object. Cancel the source transport isomorphisms to identify the conjugated unit with sectionTotalUnit. The scalar unit formula is ordinary normalization in degree zero. Identify sectionTotalIso.hom and sectionTotalUnit with the actual oplax tensor and unit maps of the termwise section pullback. Apply the naturality, associativity and both unitor identities of the existing cochain monoidal structure from lem-sfb-termwise-strong-monoidal.
